entry.name: Orks/GrotholdFlavor
entry.value: These tiny, often overlooked members inhabit makeshift strongholds crafted from salvaged materials. Armed with pint-sized weapons and piloting comically small vehicles, Grots within Grot-holdz exemplify the Orks' resourcefulness in integrating even the smallest members into their chaotic approach to warfare.

entry.name: Orks/NobhutsFlavor
entry.value: NobHutz is a chaotic fortress at the heart of an Ork settlement, serving as both housing for elite Ork Nobz and a secure vault for their plundered loot. Constructed from salvaged scrap, the exterior features a rugged, haphazard design with spikes and glyphs. Inside, reinforced living quarters for Nobz are filled with trophies, while a central Loot Room guards the amassed treasures. The fortress embodies Ork culture, reflecting their love for combat and the accumulation of plunder in a bustling, ramshackle charm.
